title: The Separation name discards necessary stronger conditions.
details: Revision 2026-01-31, Lemma25.7, printed/PDF p.102. The proposed name retains only pairs (sigma-prime,p) already attached in sigma for which p forces the formula. Let sigma contain only (check(empty),1), and let the formula say that the first bit of a Cohen generic is zero. The top condition does not force it, so the proposed name is empty even in a generic extension where the formula holds and the required subset is a singleton. Repair: include (sigma-prime,q) whenever some (sigma-prime,p) belongs to sigma, q is stronger than p, and q forces the formula. Directedness of the generic filter and truth give the required equality.
